apps.name: BPlayer
apps.summary: A local-first audiobook player for your own media and authorized Bilibili sources. Build a library, shape your albums, and pick up where you left off.
description: Bring your own audio and video into editable local albums. Keep chapters in your preferred order, save bookmarks, and return to the listening position that belongs to each album.

Explore Bilibili sources through an explicit provider, preview imports, and choose what becomes part of your library. Local files work without an account; online sources remain subject to the provider's access rules.
BPlayer is a Flutter-based prototype. Windows is the primary verification host; Android, iOS, and macOS are development targets, not certified releases.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.status: Primary preview platform. Requires the complete application bundle and, where needed, the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.status: Experimental target. Native background audio, headset, and vehicle integration still need physical-device validation.

platforms.name: iOS
platforms.status: Experimental target. An unsigned IPA cannot be installed as a normal App Store app; authorized signing and provisioning are required.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.status: Experimental target. Distribution signing, notarization, and native release validation must be confirmed per package.

features.title: A library that stays yours
features.description: Import your own media, rename albums, reorder chapters, and maintain local collections independently of their source.

features.title: Resume, without the guesswork
features.description: Per-album listening positions, bookmarks, a listening timeline, and sequential, repeat, or shuffle playback.

features.title: Offline, with permission
features.description: Save authorized audio to app-private storage and manage saved files separately from caches and original media.

features.title: Bilibili, explicitly connected
features.description: Discover and import permitted videos and collections. Preview source changes before applying them to an album.

features.title: A player that adapts
features.description: Compact and desktop layouts, a separate queue, audio/video switching, and saved appearance preferences.

features.title: English & Simplified Chinese
features.description: Choose the interface language without changing your own album names or source metadata.

apps.notice: Personal and educational use. Respect copyright, provider terms, and content permissions. Do not download or redistribute media without permission. BPlayer is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bilibili.
installation: Only download packages you are authorized to use. Read the signing status and installation notes for the specific build.
For a Windows ZIP, extract the entire archive and keep the full bundle together. Close an older BPlayer instance before launching the included executable.
Do not disable operating-system or company security policies to run a package. Ad-hoc and self-signed development builds are not publicly trusted releases.
Import your own audio or video to listen without a provider account. Local imports reference the original files, so moving those files makes them unavailable.
